data: Amazon (AMZN) delivered a fiscal 2024 that paired solid top-line expansion with a sharp step-up in profitability. Revenue reached $638.0 billion in fiscal 2024, up from $574.8 billion in fiscal 2023, representing growth of 11.0%. Gross profit rose to $311.7 billion in fiscal 2024 from $270.0 billion in fiscal 2023, translating to a fiscal 2024 gross margin of 48.9%. The operating line showed the strongest leverage, with operating income climbing to $68.6 billion in fiscal 2024 from $36.9 billion in fiscal 2023 and the fiscal 2024 operating margin standing at 10.8%. Net income increased to $59.2 billion in fiscal 2024 from $30.4 billion in fiscal 2023, a gain of 94.7%, while diluted EPS advanced to $5.53 per share in fiscal 2024 from $2.90 per share in fiscal 2023. Earnings growth far outpacing revenue growth is the core of our constructive view.
